description.p: A firearm's ammunition is spent when it is fired and cannot be recovered afterwards.

A weapon with this property can make a normal attack against one target, or spray a 10-foot cube within its normal range instead: each creature in the cube must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or take the weapon's normal damage. Spraying spends ten pieces of ammunition.
A weapon with this property fires a limited number of shots, after which it must be reloaded with an action or a bonus action.
